roots.beginner_clue: A source jar hums a half-tone sharper, and its purple deepens a shade, when the Chime is near.
roots.advanced_uses: Pour a Working's Thrum into the jars beside an apparatus, or lend an ally of the other art a breath of mana.
roots.interactions: LIFE grows what source feeds; a Working that reaches no jar and no caster gives nothing; the Seal keeps a share of every exchange.
roots.kin: A source jar hums a half-tone sharper, and its purple deepens a shade, when the Chime is near.
roots.meaning: The raw magic of the other art, that its jars hold and its creatures carry: made, it pours into the jars beside the touched ground or into a caster's reserve; found, source jars and the magical creatures that bear it.
